title: Sessions page: the grid uses the screen, the footer becomes a status rail, year/month/day scoping, a left rail for sub-views

chat.text: Measured first, then fixed: the first row of the sessions grid moves into the top quarter of the page, the 200-plus pixel near-empty footer becomes a one-line status rail, the useless inbox link goes, left padding matches the gutter; year, month and day become breadcrumb routes that scope the list with month as the default, newest first; sub-views (docs, other dashboard versions, health, cost) sit in a left rail instead of a second tab row. Before and after screenshots at four widths.
